equation_summary: Per token (dplr/naive.py:28-36): S' = Diag(exp(gk_t)) S_{t-1} with gk_t in R^K channel-wise log decay; kv_t = k_t ⊗ v_t + (alpha_t^T S_{t-1}) ⊗ beta_t (low-rank term read off the PRE-decay state, committed along beta); S_t = S' + kv_t; o_t = (scale*q_t)^T S_t. Transition is Diag(exp(gk)) + beta alpha^T — diagonal PLUS rank-1 (DPLR), strictly generalizing IPLR (031) by the channel-diagonal factor. Note ordering detail: the low-rank read uses the un-decayed S_{t-1} while the diagonal decay multiplies it (naive.py:34-35).
ledger_verdicts: CONFIRM call graph E[QKV/diagonal+left/right factors] ; B[K2 D+LR^T transition] ; E[output]: mixer operands are k,v,alpha,beta,gk — diagonal gk plus left/right factors, exactly D+LR^T (naive.py:16,34-35).

CONFIRM 'Diagonal distinct from rank factors; no IPLR default': gk is an independent channel-decay operand and the rank-1 read (alpha^T S) is computed from the PRE-decay state and added to the decayed state (naive.py:34-35) — DPLR is not IPLR-with-a-default; the ordering must be preserved.
CONFIRM rank growth and boundary state: chunked form (naive.py:57-99) uses gk cumsum and a forward-substituted A_ab inverse; all factor VJPs required.

Whether IPLR is admitted as the gk=0 special case of the DPLR descriptor or remains a separate descriptor (ledger keeps them as separate rows).
